about: Mission 01's opening, 'The Day the World Fractured': the owner's cinematic script (CINE_*, with the owner's ten recorded lines as `provided`), the campaign draft's Mission 01/02 lines used in the escape (referenced by their draft ids in m01 scenes), and the lines written to join them (M01X_*). Speakers PLAYER are voiced per body (male / female / robot). An empty speaker is the player's inner voice: subtitles only.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Six forty-seven in Nexus City. Clear skies over the harbor, light traffic on the Spire Loop.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: And the Capitol says the stability towers finish their maintenance cycle by noon. Stay with us.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: Call me when you're up. Love you.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Morning, neighbor! Coffee in the Sky Lounge later? Eleventh floor. Don't be late.

lines.speaker: NEXUS ALERT
lines.text: Grid maintenance near the stability towers today. Expect flickers.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Authorities are investigating unusual atmospheric disturbances reported overnight.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: We're receiving reports of an unidentified phenomenon above the central district—

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What the hell?!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Neural synchronization detected.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who said that?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: My designation is NOVA. There isn't time to explain.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Explain what?!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your reality is collapsing. You need to move. Now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And whatever you do, don't touch the fractures.

lines.speaker: BUILDING
lines.text: Emergency. Structural event. Elevators offline. Use the emergency stairs.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Is anyone there? I'm stuck in the Sky Lounge on eleven. The doors jammed. Please!

lines.speaker: RESIDENT
lines.text: Get out! Get out of the building!

lines.speaker: RESIDENT
lines.text: Where are the stairs? I can't see anything!

lines.speaker: RESIDENT
lines.text: Somebody help me!

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: You came back for me. Go, go. I'm right behind you.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Something's coming out of the smoke. Move!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your body just answered the Fracture. Armor forming. Weapon system online.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Point it at them and squeeze. Your hands know how.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's happening to me?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something big is anchoring itself to the tear. Your resonance is spiking.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Don't hold it back. Let it out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Readings settling. You did that.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: What did they do to you? What are you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't know yet either. Stay with me. We'll learn the rest as we go.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Breathe. Find one in your sights. Squeeze.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Reach for it. The surge in your chest: release it at the anchor.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Every city on this world woke up somewhere new this morning.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Nexus was only the first to notice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we'd better find out where we are.
